description: Copy a doc, presentation or storyboard to start the next round from, keeping the original as it is. The copy is private to your human and lands in the same space when they can open it; comments, versions and sharing stay behind. A storyboard's copy picks from the same roll, and a presentation's drops slides not written yet.
